market_outlook.short_term: Markets face a tug-of-war: strong jobs data supports Fed hawkishness while Trump demands cuts. Oil at $97 and diesel highs create inflationary pressure. S&P 500 likely range-bound with elevated volatility. Energy and defense outperform; rate-sensitive sectors under pressure. European markets vulnerable to gas supply shock into October.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle (GPT-6, Nvidia-Hugging Face, Anthropic IPO) drives multi-year tech earnings growth. Energy transition accelerated by war-driven supply constraints. Auto industry restructuring continues. US fiscal sustainability questioned by sovereign wealth fund Treasury exit. Defense spending structurally elevated. Consumer resilience depends on wage-inflation gap narrowing.
